manualTimestamps.title: Manual Timestamp Creation
manualTimestamps.description: Unlike other bloated tools in the market, this one is simple yet powerful. It helps you create timestamps manually which ensures precision, yet the interface helps you create it 50% faster, with controls from start of the chapter to end of the YouTube video's chapter.

videoIntegration.title: Video Integration
videoIntegration.description: Support for MP4 file uploads and direct YouTube URL loading. Responsive video player with precise controls for seamless playback experience.

instantExport.title: Instant Export

questions.whatIsAnswer: Easy Timestamps is a free tool that helps you create professional YouTube timestamps and video chapters quickly and efficiently.
questions.howToUse: How do I use Easy Timestamps?
questions.howToUseAnswer: Simply paste a YouTube URL or upload a video file, then add timestamps with titles. You can export the results in various formats.
questions.supportedFormatsAnswer: We support YouTube URLs and MP4 file uploads. More formats coming soon.
questions.freeToUse: Is Easy Timestamps free to use?
questions.freeToUseAnswer: Yes! Easy Timestamps is completely free to use with no hidden fees or subscriptions.
questions.exportFormatsAnswer: You can export timestamps in YouTube description format, JSON, CSV, and plain text formats.
